name: After Years
source:
After Years is an adult themed Visual Novel that features kemono (furry) characters.

The story revolves around Welkin – a young wolf who after six years finally reunites with his childhood friends during late, summer vacations.

Spend a week in the peaceful, seaside town Rochelle, living your life to the fullest. Make decisions that will affect relations between protagonist and his friends – strengthen up dimmed bonds by becoming closer friends or go a step further by starting a romance relationship. The love knows no bounds.

[From the [url=https://afteryears.wordpress.com/about/]official site[/url]]
translation:
《多年之后》是一部成人主题的视觉小说，以兽（毛茸茸的）角色为特色。

故事围绕着一只小狼威尔金展开，六年后，他终于在暑假末与儿时的朋友们团聚。

在宁静的海滨小镇罗谢尔度过一周的时光，尽情享受你的生活。做出会影响主角和他的朋友之间关系的决定——通过成为更亲密的朋友来加强暗淡的联系，或者通过开始一段浪漫关系来更进一步。爱是没有界限的。

[来自[url=https://afteryears.wordpress.com/about/]官方网站[/url]]
